layout.arrangement: No top title bar; full-bleed white canvas. Left ~66% is a 2-column x 4-row grid of red-bordered threshold panels: column 1 top-to-bottom = Threshold 0.0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.4; column 2 top-to-bottom = Threshold 0.6, 0.7, 1, and a centered title box reading 'ROC Curve for Same Model -different thresholds'. Right ~34% is split vertically: top ~70% is the ROC line chart (with a yellow circular badge '36' at its top-right corner), bottom ~28% is a strip holding two stacked formula boxes on the left and a small green-highlighted confusion-matrix legend on the right.

layout.hierarchy: The panel grid (left) and the ROC chart (right) are co-dominant. Within panels, bold red threshold labels and red TPR/FPR text pop against white; blue vs red matrix numbers encode actual class. On the right, the purple curve is the strongest color accent, followed by the green 'best point' callout and red 'Best (TPR)'/'Best (FPR)' callouts; the yellow '36' badge is a small corner marker.

visual_elements.description: ROC line chart (scatter-with-lines). X axis 'FPR' 0 to 1 (red label, bottom), Y axis 'TPR' 0 to 1 (red label, left). Light-blue gridlines on white. Single purple line with circular markers through points (FPR,TPR): (0,0) labeled '1.0'; (0,0.6) labeled '0.7'; (0.16,0.6) labeled '0.6'; (0.16,0.8) labeled '0.4'; (0.33,1) labeled '0.3'; (0.66,1) labeled '0.1'; (1,1) labeled '0.0'. Threshold labels sit in small white boxes with thin gray borders. A solid green dot marks (0,1). Annotations: green text 'The Best (If Any)' upper-left with green block arrow to the green dot; red text 'Best (TPR)' near top with red block arrow pointing to the '0.3' point; red text 'Best (FPR)' mid-chart with red block arrow pointing left to the '0.4' point.
Two stacked pale boxes at bottom-right-left containing fraction-style formulas in dark red: 'TPR = TP/(TP+FN)' (TP over TP+FN) and 'FPR = FP/(FP+TN)' (FP over FP+TN).

Legend confusion matrix, 3x3: header 'Predicted as' merged over columns 'P' and 'N'; vertical 'Actual' label at left; row headers 'P' and 'N'; cells: P row = TP, FN; N row = FP, TN. TP and TN cells are filled bright green.
colors: #00FF00 highlight on TP and TN cells

Plus the solid green dot at (0,1).

imagery: No photographic imagery. Only vector icons/shapes: a yellow circular slide-number badge '36' (top-right), a solid green dot at (0,1) on the ROC plot, and three block callout arrows (one green, two red) used as annotations on the chart.
typography_notes: All text is a clean sans-serif (Calibri/Arial-like). Threshold labels are bold red inside thin red-bordered rectangles. Matrix headers are bold black on gray fill; 'Actual' appears as a vertical (rotated) label on the left of each matrix. TPR/FPR lines are red regular weight on pale-yellow boxes. Chart annotations: green for 'The Best (If Any)', red for 'Best (TPR)' and 'Best (FPR)'. Axis names TPR/FPR and single-letter codes P/N/TP/FN/FP/TN are uppercase. No italics, no numbered bullets.
animation_state: Static, fully revealed; nothing appears mid-build.
recreation_brief: 1. Start with a blank white 16:9 slide; do not add a title placeholder.

2. Draw the left grid: 8 red-bordered rectangles (border ~1.5pt, #C04040) in 2 columns x 4 rows covering x ~4-66%, y ~6-98%. Column 1 top-to-bottom: Threshold=0.0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.4. Column 2 top-to-bottom: Threshold=0.6, 0.7, 1, and the title box cell.

3. In each of the 7 threshold panels: (a) small white box with red border at the panel's top-left containing bold red text 'Threshold=X'; (b) a 3x3 table on the left with gray (#C0C0C0) header cells - top-left cell holds 'Actual' rotated 90 degrees, 'Predicted as' merged across the two right columns, column headers 'P' and 'N', row headers 'P' and 'N'; (c) fill the four data cells with P-row values in blue (#0000FF) and N-row values in red (#FF0000): 0.0 -> 5,0 / 6,0; 0.1 -> 5,0 / 4,2; 0.3 -> 5,0 / 2,4; 0.4 -> 4,1 / 1,5; 0.6 -> 3,1 / 1,5; 0.7 -> 3,2 / 0,6; 1 -> 0,5 / 0,6; (d) to the right of the table, a pale-yellow (#FFFFCC) box with two lines of red text: 0.0: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1','FPR=6/(6+0)=1'; 0.1: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1','FPR=4/(4+2)=0.66'; 0.3: 'TPR=5/(5+0)=1','FPR=2/(2+4)=0.33'; 0.4: 'TPR=4/(4+1)=4/5','FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16'; 0.6: 'TPR=3/(3+1)=0.6','FPR=1/(1+5)=0.16'; 0.7: 'TPR=3/(3+2)=0.6','FPR=0/(0+6)=0'; 1: 'TPR=0/(0+5)=0','FPR=0/(0+6)=0'.
4. In the 8th grid cell (bottom of column 2) place a centered text box, dark red (#C00000) bold, two lines: 'ROC Curve for' / 'Same Model -different thresholds'.
5. Right side: draw the ROC plot area x ~66-99%, y ~6-76%, white fill with light-blue (#B0E0E6) gridlines; add red axis labels 'TPR' (vertical, left side) and 'FPR' (horizontal, bottom).
6. Plot one purple (#9932CC) line with circle markers through (FPR,TPR): (0,0), (0,0.6), (0.16,0.6), (0.16,0.8), (0.33,1), (0.66,1), (1,1).

7. Add small white label boxes with thin gray borders next to each point: '1.0' at (0,0), '0.7' at (0,0.6), '0.6' at (0.16,0.6), '0.4' at (0.16,0.8), '0.3' at (0.33,1), '0.1' at (0.66,1), '0.0' at (1,1).

8. Add a solid green (#00B050) dot at (0,1); green text 'The Best (If Any)' at upper-left with a green block arrow pointing to the dot; red text 'Best (TPR)' near the top with a red block arrow pointing to the '0.3' point; red text 'Best (FPR)' mid-chart with a red block arrow pointing left to the '0.4' point.
9. Top-right corner of the chart: yellow (#FFFF00) circle containing '36' in dark red (#C00000).

10. Bottom-right strip (y ~78-98%): on the left, two stacked pale-yellow boxes with fraction formulas 'TPR = TP/(TP+FN)' and 'FPR = FP/(FP+TN)' in dark red; on the right, a 3x3 legend table ('Predicted as' over 'P'/'N', 'Actual' rows 'P'/'N') with cells TP, FN / FP, TN, where the TP and TN cells are filled bright green (#00FF00).
11. Use a sans-serif font (Calibri) throughout; bold red for threshold labels; no other decoration, footers, or logos.
